Far
FAR
adv.
Webster 1828 treats FAR as adjective and adverb [Latin porro]: distant; separated by a wide space; remote from purpose; remote in affection or obedience; alienated in a spiritual sense. Adverb: to a great extent or distance; in a great proportion. He cites Joshua 9:6, Matthew 25:14, Exodus 8:28, Proverbs 31:10, Philippians 1:23, and Ephesians 2:13. This page fills the KJV-gap common of distance God names and distance God closes. Companion pages already treat nigh and peace.

Biblical Definition

Far in Scripture is not a vibe of independence and not a travel brand. It is the distance of transgression removed, the alienation closed by blood, and the LORD far from the wicked. As far as the east is from the west, so far hath He removed our transgressions from us (Psa 103:12). Ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ (Eph 2:13). Peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD (Isa 57:19). Thou art not far from the kingdom of God (Mar 12:34). The LORD is far from the wicked: but He heareth the prayer of the righteous (Pro 15:29). The dictionary therefore keeps far from becoming either wanderlust or a therapy of space. God removes, or you stay far.

Webster 1828 Definition

Webster 1828 defines FAR as adjective: distant; remote from purpose; remote in affection or obedience; alienated. Adverb: to a great extent or distance; in a great proportion. He cites Joshua 9:6, Matthew 25:14, Exodus 8:28, Proverbs 31:10, Philippians 1:23, Ephesians 2:13.

expand to see more

F'AR, adjective [Latin porro; Gr. connected with, a way, a passing, to pass or go. See Fare.]

1. Distant, in any direction; separated by a wide space from the place where one is, or from any given place remote.

They said, we are come from a far country. Joshua 9:6.

The kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country. Matthew 25:14.

3. Remote in affection or obedience; at enmity with; alienated; in a spiritual sense.

F'AR, adverb

1. To a great extent or distance of space.

Only ye shall not go very far away. Exodus 8:28.

5. In a great proportion; by many degrees; very much.

Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies. Proverbs 31:10.

Ye, who were sometime far off, are made nigh by the blood of Christ. Ephesians 2:13.

Key Scripture

Psa 103:12 — "As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us."

Eph 2:13 — "But now in Christ Jesus ye who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ."

Isa 57:19 — "I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the LORD; and I will heal him."

Mar 12:34 — "And when Jesus saw that he answered discreetly, he said unto him, Thou art not far from the kingdom of God. And no man after that durst ask him any question."

Pro 15:29 — "The LORD is far from the wicked: but he heareth the prayer of the righteous."

Modern Corruption

Far is corrupted when distance is recast as authentic selfhood, when far-off is kept as a mood, and when the blood that makes nigh is swapped for a journey.

expand to see more

The first corruption is wanderlust as piety. Psalm 103:12 is transgression removed as far as east from west — God's act, not a gap year. The age keeps the miles and drops the mercy.

The second corruption is alienation as identity. Ephesians 2:13 is ye who were far off made nigh by the blood of Christ. A brand of outsider is not that far-off.

The third corruption is nearness without the kingdom. Mark 12:34 is not far from the kingdom of God. Proverbs 15:29: the LORD is far from the wicked. Sentiment is not arrival.

"Blood: ye who were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ (Eph 2:13); peace to him that is far off (Isa 57:19)."

"Kingdom: thou art not far from the kingdom of God (Mar 12:34). The LORD is far from the wicked (Pro 15:29)."
